result.title: LoopVQ: Sub 1-bit KV Cache Quantization for Looped Transformers
result.summary: Looped transformers are a parameter-efficient alternative to standard transformers for language modeling. By reapplying the same layers across multiple loop steps, recent looped language models match the performance of non-looped models several times their size. While this architecture effectively reduces parameter memory, each loop step still stores its own keys and values, so the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with the number of loop steps and becomes the main memory bottleneck. We observe that the KV cache of looped models is highly redundant along the loop axis and that the loop steps differ substantially in their sensitivity to quantization. Based on these observations, we propose $\textbf{LoopVQ}$, a KV cache vector quantization method for looped transformers that codes channels of multiple loop steps jointly, and fine-tunes the codebooks to match the output of the full-precision model. At 0.5 bits per element, LoopVQ outperforms existing KV cache vector quantization methods for standard LLMs on general, long chain-of-thought reasoning, and long-context retrieval tasks with Ouro and Huginn models. Its design is orthogonal to these methods, and combined with TaSQ, it retains much of the BF16 accuracy even at 0.25 bits per element. We also implement LoopVQ in SGLang, where it nearly halves the decode latency at a 32K-token context and raises the peak serving throughput by up to $4.3\times$ and $6.1\times$ on the 1.4B and 2.6B Ouro models compared to the BF16 baseline.

AI.brief_summary: 研究循环 Transformer 中随循环步线性增长的 KV cache 冗余与分步量化敏感性问题，提出跨多个循环步联合编码通道并微调码本的向量量化方法，在 Ouro、Huginn 上评估精度与推理加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽不涉及视觉推理，但循环步状态的高冗余与不同步量化敏感度，可供核查 LVR 中循环推理状态的压缩表示、深度/位置影响及实际推理成本。
